diagnosis: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma in BAP1 tumour predisposition syndrome
legend: This tumour demonstrates typical morphological features.

diagnosis: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma in BAP1 tumour predisposition syndrome
legend: Immunohistochemistry shows a complete loss of expression of BAP1 in all neoplastic cells. The non-neoplastic cells demonstrate retained nuclear expression and serve as an internal positive control.

diagnosis: Skin lesion in BAP1 tumour predisposition syndrome
legend: Representative section of a 7 mm irregular papule in a patient with germline heterozygous BAP1 pathogenic mutation (NM_004656.3 BAP1 c.102_109del; p.D34Efs*32). The section shows an intradermal proliferation composed largely of epithelioid melanocytes with round to oval nuclei, abundant glassy cytoplasm, and haphazard maturation. There is nuclear pleomorphism and an occasional nuclear pseudoinclusion. Mitotic figures are not readily identified.

diagnosis: Skin lesion in BAP1 tumour predisposition syndrome
legend: BAP1 immunohistochemistry in this skin papule reveals that the lesional melanocytes lack nuclear expression of BAP1.
